questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: A) The correct spelling of ‘Encraoch’ is ‘Encroach’which means “to intrude on (a person's territory or a thing considered to be a right)” अतिक्रमण करना, अतिक्रमण करना.

questions.question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.
A distinguished academecian, Amartya Sen has taught in India, Britain and the United States
questions.solution: B)The correct spelling of ‘Academecian’ is ‘Academician’ which means “a member of an academy, especially of the Royal Academy of Arts or the Académie Française” अकादमिक सदस्य.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: D)The correct spelling of 'Aquire' is'Acquire'which means "to gain possession of something" प्राप्त करना, हासिल करना.

questions.question:
There is a spelling error in the given sentence. Select the option that contains the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
The precious bookshelf was carefully decorated with religiuos books
questions.solution: A) The correct spelling of ‘religiuos’ is ‘religious’which means “relating to or believing in a religion” धार्मिक.

questions.question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence and select its correct spelling from the given options.
The committee heard that he had been negliegent in his duty
questions.solution: D)The correct spelling of ‘negliegent’ is ‘Negligent’which means “failing to take proper care in doing something” लापरवाह.

questions.question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.
‘Vande Mataram’, a poignant poem, is obviously and indisputebly the premier national song of India.
questions.solution: C) The incorrect spelling in the sentence is ‘Indisputebly’. The correct spelling is ‘Indisputably’ which means “in a manner that cannot be challenged or denied” निर्विवाद रूप से.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
questions.solution: B) The correct spelling of 'Dissappoint' is'Disappoint,' which means "to fail to fulfill the hopes or expectations of someone" निराश करना.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: A)The correct spelling of ‘marijuena’ is ‘marijuana’which means “the dried leaves and flowers of the hemp plant, used in medicine or as a drug” गांजा, भांग.

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word
questions.solution: A)The correct spelling of ‘Ilusion’ is ‘Illusion’which means “a thing that is or is likely to be wrongly perceived or interpreted by the senses” भ्रांति, भ्रम.

questions.question:
Select the option that corrects the following sentence.
He has broken his leg yesterday
options: 2) He has broke his leg yesterday.
3) He had broke his leg yesterday.
4) He have broken his leg yesterday
questions.solution:
A)'Broke'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'yesterday' समय को निर्दिष्ट करता है, और Past Tense का प्रयोग आवश्यक है; जैसे— He broke his leg yesterday.
'broke'will be used because 'yesterday' specifies a time in the past, and the Past Tense is required; Like— He broke his leg yesterday.

questions.question:
Identify the incorrectly spelt word and select its correct spelling.
Wether we want to admit it or not, we all wish everyone would like us.
questions.solution: D) The incorrect spelling in the given sentence is ‘Wether’. The correct spelling is ‘Whether’ which means "expressing a doubt or choice between alternatives" या, चाहे.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: B) The correct spelling of 'Magnanimos' is'Magnanimous'which means "generous or forgiving, especially towards a rival or less powerful person" उदार, विशालह्रदय.

questions.question:

questions.question:
